name: trust-assurance
title: Trust and assurance section
description: Transparent questions to ask about security, reliability, and data handling; not certification claims.

files.content:
Trust needs evidence.

Replace these sample prompts with verified policies and public documentation.

  • Access controls

    Describe how permissions are enforced and audited.

  • Data handling

    Publish retention, export and deletion policies.

  • Incident response

    Explain reporting channels and response expectations.

Read our documented practices
